title: Sergeant Hard Rules registry
description: Machine-readable registry of the 15 hard rules from AGENTS.md. The registry is the source-of-truth for the rule list — `docs/governance/hard-rules-matrix.md` is generated from this file via `scripts/docs/generate-hard-rules-matrix.mjs`. The full prose description of each rule still lives in AGENTS.md (different audience: humans need narrative, machines need structure).

version.description: Schema version. Bump when you add/remove fields or change semantics.

generatedFrom.description: Which AGENTS.md section this registry was extracted from. Lets the matrix generator note its provenance.

id.description: Stable identifier (HR-1 … HR-N). Matches the rule's `### N.` heading number in AGENTS.md so links survive section renumbering.

summary.description: One-sentence plain-English summary suitable for CLI output and PR templates.

severity.description: `error` = CI/lint blocks merge. `warning` = lint warns but does not block. `convention` = enforced via review / playbooks only.

since.description: First date the rule was recorded as a hard rule. Best-effort estimate for older rules.

owner.description: GitHub handle responsible for keeping the rule current.

appliesTo.description: Glob-style paths where the rule is in scope. Empty / omitted = repo-wide.

enforcement.description: Mechanisms that automatically detect violations. Empty = manual / review-only.

seeAlso.description: Related playbooks, ADRs, or PRs (relative repo paths or URLs).

path.description: Glob-pointer to the test files that lock the contract.

what.description: 1-line description of what the tests assert.

path.description: Path to the script that enforces the rule (relative to repo root).

workflow.description: Path to the GitHub Actions workflow (relative to repo root).

what.description: GitHub branch-protection rule (configured in repo settings, not in code).
Convention enforced via PR review only.
